Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one complete illustrated Kikimashta achievement badge, genuine transparent background with alpha.
Reference 1 is the OWNER-APPROVED Strong WK badge: match its illustrated style, chunky violet outlines, puffy rounded forms, creamy center, friendly rounded WK lettering and large curved ribbon with folded ends. Reference 2 is the approved Mastered suitcase badge: use only for the same soft shading/color family and as the upper-rank complexity ceiling. Preserve the approved cheerful golden-yellow, lavender and pink illustration language. This is an independent new mastery design, NOT another copy of the Strong star or Mastered crown.
All six new prototypes use WaniKani Pictures level 1 so the rank designs can be compared directly. Large centered exact "WK" inside the creamy medallion, no crab, no suitcase, no other animals. A prominent curved folded banner across the lower front has the same simple landscape/picture symbol on the left and exact "L1" on the right. Both icon and letters conform to the curved banner surface. Text must read only "WK" and "L1": no rank name, extra labels or captions.
Straight-on view, complete silhouette, about 80% of a square canvas with generous transparent margins. Keep center/ribbon proportions and typography consistent with reference 1. Soft internal shading gives the same dimensional illustrated quality; no thin flat vector linework, photorealistic metal, brown antiquing, white shine streaks, backdrop, checkerboard or watermark. Keep artwork readable around 56–64 px. No crown or wings; those are reserved for Mastered.

Rank design: NEW: the simplest rank. A substantial soft lavender circular seal with a single rounded rim, creamy WK face and a pale pink folded ribbon. Calm and welcoming, minimal ornament, no star points, leaves or wreath. It must still feel beautifully illustrated and dimensional.
